claim: Light rays and free fall determine conformal/projective structure but not metric scale
closest_precedent: Ehlers-Pirani-Schild; Perlick standard clocks; Fatibene et al. time protocols
overlap: Direct precedent for causal/conformal reconstruction and clock-based gauge fixing.
residual_candidate: None at this level.

claim: A bona fide clock can select the remaining scale of a conformal spacetime
closest_precedent: Fatibene et al.; Svozil single-unit theorem
overlap: Direct precedent; Svozil gives a recent formal single-clock scale-fixing treatment.
residual_candidate: Extend from one normalization to local compatibility of an entire family of spectra.

claim: Massless physics supplies conformal geometry while mass generation completes chronometric geometry
closest_precedent: Bradonjić massless spacetime; Rainer emergent spacetime proposal
overlap: Very close conceptual precedent linking electroweak mass to full geometry/clocks.
residual_candidate: Recast as a precise multi-clock consistency theorem rather than a slogan.

claim: Physical time may be represented by counting field oscillations
closest_precedent: Wetterich physical time
overlap: Direct precedent for phase/oscillation-count clocks.
residual_candidate: Require universality across inequivalent clock species.

claim: Higgs/gravitational scalar sectors determine atomic measurement gauge
closest_precedent: Scholz; Hobson and Lasenby
overlap: Direct precedent connecting mass-generating scalar fields, Weyl gauge and proper time.
residual_candidate: Spectral factorization criterion and differential obstruction.

claim: Higgs-dilaton dynamics can modify or define clock rates
closest_precedent: Nguyen Higgs-dilaton varying-light-speed/clock model
overlap: Direct precedent for Higgs-dilaton-dependent clock calibration.
residual_candidate: Demand one common factor for all spectra and identify violations species-by-species.

claim: All particle and gravitational mass scales can descend from one scalar source
closest_precedent: Higgs-dilaton, local conformal Standard Model and cosmon scaling literature
overlap: Extensive direct prior art.
residual_candidate: Interpret the shared scale as a necessary chronometric compatibility field.

claim: Every clock defines the same proper-time metric iff all local frequencies factorize as omega_A=c_A chi
closest_precedent: Universal scalar coupling, local-position-invariance and single-clock conformal gauge literature
overlap: Ingredients are familiar; no exact indexed statement of the local many-clock iff theorem was found.
residual_candidate: The theorem, its exact hypotheses and uniqueness result; likely mathematically elementary, so novelty is formulation/use rather than difficult proof.

claim: Differential one-forms S_AB=d ln(omega_A/omega_B) are the invariant obstruction to one metric time
closest_precedent: Atomic-clock sensitivity coefficients and differential variation of constants
overlap: The measured quantities are standard; the geometric obstruction interpretation and package were not found verbatim.
residual_candidate: Define chronometric shear as a conformal-gauge invariant field on clock space.

claim: Log-frequency space modulo common-mode translations is the natural clock-space quotient
closest_precedent: Common-mode rejection in clock comparisons; Weyl transformation of masses
overlap: Linear algebra is standard; no exact clock-space quotient formalism was found in targeted searches.
residual_candidate: Coordinate-free quotient/line-bundle formulation and connection to conformal geometry.

claim: r independent non-universal scalar fields imply a differential clock-drift data matrix of rank at most r
closest_precedent: Multi-parameter clock sensitivity matrices
source: Atomic-clock variation analyses, including arXiv:2302.04565 and arXiv:2606.27388
overlap: Sensitivity matrices are routine; the rank bound as a model-counting signature was not found as an explicit theorem in this audit.
residual_candidate: Prove identifiability conditions, include noise/systematics and test on real networks.

claim: One Higgs-dilaton misalignment scalar produces rank-one correlated clock-ratio drift
closest_precedent: Single ultralight scalar coupled with species-dependent sensitivities
overlap: The linear response is implicit in standard scalar searches.
residual_candidate: Embed as the falsification signature of the universal-clock theorem.

claim: The ordinary Standard Model Higgs alone is a universal clock scale
closest_precedent: Standard Model mass generation and varying-constant literature
overlap: Contradicted by independent QCD, gravitational and dimensionless-coupling dependence.
residual_candidate: Only conditionally possible if deeper dynamics locks all dimensionless ratios and all scales to h.

claim: Higgs-only induced gravity is a viable minimal completion
closest_precedent: Atkins and Calmet bound on Higgs-curvature coupling
overlap: Induced gravity needs xi about 10^32; collider Higgs data bound it far below this and such a Higgs would decouple.
residual_candidate: Use an additional gravitational scalar or other Planck-scale order parameter.

claim: The Standard Model Higgs can be the sole local Weyl compensator while retaining the observed Higgs
closest_precedent: Conformal compensator analyses; Weyl-gauge Standard Model models
overlap: In the simplest model the remaining radial Higgs is gauge-removed/eaten; viable constructions add a scalar or gravitational mode.
residual_candidate: Radial compensator plus angular Higgs alignment.

claim: Minimal classically scale-invariant Standard Model radiatively generates the observed electroweak vacuum
closest_precedent: Foot et al. and minimal scale-invariant extension literature
overlap: Known failure: heavy top prevents required bosonic dominance; additional bosons/dynamics are needed.
residual_candidate: Hidden-sector dimensional transmutation transmitted by a portal.

claim: A deeper radial field chi with h=rho sin theta, chi=rho cos theta cleanly separates scale and Higgs alignment
closest_precedent: Higgs-dilaton and local conformal scalar parameterizations
overlap: Radial/angular decomposition is standard.
residual_candidate: Use rho as the universal spectral factor and theta as chronometric shear source.

claim: Electromagnetism supplies the universal scale of time
closest_precedent: Conformal invariance of Maxwell theory
overlap: Free EM transports phases and causal structure but has no intrinsic absolute frequency scale.
residual_candidate: EM supplies phase transport/readout after a mass/scale sector supplies normalization.

claim: Higgs relay + deeper scale field + EM phase readout reconstructs operational duration
closest_precedent: Combination of Higgs-dilaton, atomic spectra, conformal clocks and phase-count time literature
overlap: Every ingredient has precedent; the exact three-role synthesis and theorem-driven selection criterion were not found as a single construction.
residual_candidate: A narrowly claimed theorem/model-selection paper, not a broad claim that the Higgs creates time.

claim: Exact universal scaling is locally unobservable in clock ratios
closest_precedent: Frame/unit equivalence and scalar-tensor universal conformal coupling
overlap: Established principle: only dimensionless ratios are locally observable.
residual_candidate: Use this as the non-circularity boundary: physical novelty requires gravity dynamics, generated scale, or controlled non-universality.

claim: Chronometric geometry is physically more than a choice of units only if the same field also has dynamics or predicts residuals
closest_precedent: Jordan/Einstein frame equivalence and compensator literature
overlap: Conceptually established; the criterion is a useful synthesis.
residual_candidate: Make it a precise model-admissibility condition.
